title: Dhokha (2007)
desc: Police Inspector Zaid is shocked when he learns that Sara, his late wife, is suspected to be a suicide bomber. However, he sets out to learn Sara's side of the story and gets justice for her.

title: Mohalla Assi
desc: The honest priest Pandeyji, finds that the locals of Banaras manipulate foreign tourists with fake spiritual gurus. He decides to intervene in the matter to set it right.

title: Rang Rasiya
desc: A young and talented Raja Ravi Varma trains under the king of Kerala. He moves to British-era Bombay and meets Sugandha, who initially discredits his artwork but later becomes his muse.

title: Joram
desc: A man and his baby, pursued by a determined cop, cross paths with a vengeful mother in a heart-pounding survival tale set in a harsh world of destruction and retribution.

title: Phone Bhoot
desc: Inspired by stories from their childhood, two young men create a business around capturing ghosts. However, their endeavour turns dangerous when they must fulfil their promise to a poltergeist.

title: Fukrey 3
desc: Two friends face ridiculous, chaotic situations together, backing each other through tough moments, and work to escape yet another awkward mess, learning resilience and loyalty along path.

title: Jersey
desc: Despite facing setbacks, Arjun, a talented cricketer in his thirties, struggles to launch his career. As pressure mounts to quit, will he find the strength to chase his dream?

title: Happy Phirr Bhag Jayegi
desc: Harpreet in Shanghai with husband, faces kidnapping attempt; wrong abduction.

title: Notebook
desc: Kabir, an ex-soldier, becomes a teacher and finds a diary left by Firdaus, a former employee of the school. He follows the writings in the book and soon finds himself falling for the writer.

title: The Killer
desc: A contract killer hires the services of a cab driver for a full night. Soon, he forces the driver to go around Dubai as he kills witnesses scheduled to testify against a gangster.

title: Thai Massage
desc: Widowed 70-year-old Atmaram Dubey defies norms to pursue self-discovery.

title: Chakravyuh
desc: Adil recruits Kabir to spy on Naxals. The mission succeeds, but Kabir grows sympathetic to their cause, causing conflict with Adil and challenging their friendship.

title: Gangster
desc: Simran is the girlfriend of Daya, a gangster. She re-locates to Seoul and befriends Akash, a singer in a restaurant. Their friendship develops into love. She has to make a choice between Daya and Akash.

title: Sniff
desc: An anosmic boy gains super smell powers and uses them to fight crime, turning into a pint-sized superhero with humor and noble purpose.

title: Sajini Shinde Ka Viral Video
desc: When a school teacher goes missing after a risque video of her is posted on the internet, a police officer is tasked with uncovering the truth behind her disappearance.

title: Manmarziyaan
desc: Rumi and Vicky, who are in love, are pressurised to get married by Rumi's family. But Vicky refuses to commit and a broker brings in Robbie as a suitor.

title: Udta Punjab
desc: A rock star, doctor, cop, and labourer battle the chaos of Punjab's drug crisis, each fighting demons as addiction and crime threaten to consume everything.

title: The Sabarmati Report
desc: A Hindi reporter struggles with a deadly fact when a train full of Karsewaks is set ablaze in Godhra. Years later, he is asked to help expose the Sabarmati Incident backed by a buried report.

title: Velle
desc: When six individuals cross paths with three criminals, their lives get intertwined with one another. What follows is a series of hilarious events as each one of them navigates their way out of chaos.

title: Bas Itna Sa Khwaab Hai
desc: An Ambitious Small-Town Man Gets An Opportunity To Work At The News Channel Of His Idol, A Media Tycoon. He Becomes A Clever Businessman And Has Everything He Ever Dreamt Of, But At A Price.

title: Tumsa Nahi Dekha
desc: Daksh, a millionaire who is always drunk, sees Jia, a stripper, on a street and falls madly in love with her. However, if he does not marry Anahita, he stands to lose his inheritance.

title: Kadvi Hawa
desc: A grim tale of farming hardship: Mahua, a farmer, faces suicide pressures. An elderly man, another farmer, and a debt collector strike a dangerous pact to survive.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: After Losing The Custody Of His Daughter Nia To His Wife, Maya, Abhay Dies In A Car Accident. However, His Spirit Continues To Haunt Their Happy And Peaceful Life.
